bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/archive.rs (ByteStream, compress_to, compress_to_threaded, decompress_from, compress_file, compress_directory, expand), springboard/sdk/src/compression.rs (encode_buffer_threaded), springboard/src/files/zip.rs (create, extract), springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs (read_tar, index_tar, extract_from), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/inflate.rs
summary: BifrOSt has an app-facing archive module in the SDK: ZIP folders and single files, raw DEFLATE for buffers, strings and byte streams, and a thread-count option for large streams. Tar reading and extraction serve app package install. The Apple Archive container format (header, entry messages, stream traits) and encrypted archives are not present.

features.feature: Compressing and extracting file system directories
features.apple: Compressing file system directories; Decompressing and extracting an archived directory
features.note: ZIP folder trees through the SDK archive module and the Files app; the ZIP format, not Apple Archive. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 compress_directory_archives_the_tree_and_expands_it_again, compress_directory_refuses_a_plain_file. Known issue: members keep the zipped folder name, so expanding nests the tree one level deeper. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: Compressing single files; Decompressing single files
features.note: Writes <file name>.zip for one file and extracts it again; ZIP format, not Apple Archive. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 compress_file_archives_one_file_and_expands_it_again, compress_file_refuses_a_folder_and_stops_when_progress_cancels. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: Compressing and saving a string to the file system; Decompressing and parsing an archived string
features.note: Raw DEFLATE of the UTF-8 bytes with a caller-given size limit; no file-system save of the string. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 text_helpers_round_trip_and_match_the_codec, decompress_text_refuses_bytes_that_are_not_utf8, decompress_reports_the_limit_and_damage_in_its_messages. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: ArchiveHeader; file ownership, permissions, flags, times, extended attributes
features.note: Tar entries keep the path, mode, directory flag, contents offset and size, and the reader refuses unsafe paths, links, pax headers, duplicates and bad checksums, as tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-12.rs; ownership, times and extended attributes are not kept, and the zip path was not checked.

features.feature: Archive streams (data blobs and byte buffers)
features.note: In-memory cursor stream with Read, Write, Seek and cancel. Not the Apple Archive stream traits. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 byte_stream_reads_from_the_cursor_after_a_seek, byte_stream_writes_past_the_end_with_zero_gap, compress_to_writes_at_the_cursor_and_decompress_from_reads_to_the_end; cancel is covered by the inline cancelled_stream_refuses_reads_writes_and_flushes. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: Multithreaded lossless compression (no thread count recorded for this row)
features.note: Inputs of 2 MiB or more are split into pieces that each become a DEFLATE block, joined into one stream; matches do not cross pieces. The Files app zip writer is still single-threaded. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 compress_to_threaded_matches_the_codec_and_round_trips_large_input, compress_to_threaded_with_one_thread_matches_the_single_step_bytes, large_input_split_over_two_threads_is_deterministic_and_round_trips. Not yet verified on Midget.

features.feature: Reading and indexing tar packages for install
features.apple: No direct equivalent; closest is the archive read path
features.note: Used by the App Store installer; headers are indexed without loading file data; not an app-facing API

Bounded by a caller-given size limit; the decoder is shared with the Books engine. Tests: parity_sdk-tests-04 raw_deflate_helpers_read_the_codec_output, decompress_reports_the_limit_and_damage_in_its_messages, decode_rejects_a_reserved_block_type. Not yet verified on Midget.

No encrypted archive format in the code. Blocked: the SDK has no cipher (springboard/sdk/src/crypto_key.rs provides HMAC authentication only), and the reference encryption profiles are not implemented.

gaps: No Apple Archive container (AAR) reader or writer, with its header, entry messages and stream model; the SDK writes ZIP and raw DEFLATE
No preservation of file ownership, extended attributes or flags in archives, as far as the code shows
No encrypted archives or encryption context; blocked until the SDK has a cipher and key derivation
Multithreaded compression covers byte streams only; the Files app zip writer runs as a single background job
No lazy matching in the DEFLATE encoder, so output is larger than a full zlib encoder
